limits: ROS1 source-only package; no custom messages or catkin build required.
Requested force is explicitly re-read per Trigger, active scale is cached at startup; no dynamic_reconfigure claim.
Measured raw native joint data and simulator time brackets are retained; the 1kg/.8 analytic model only normalizes sample time and checks predictions.
Joint damping .8 is checked in the loaded SDF, not reported as an available GetJointProperties measurement.
Default experiment does not run or grade the separate student validator.
Caller wall timeout does not cancel unknown remote requests; unknown clear is not automatically resent.
